items.title: Safety

items:
Casa Francisca is a 3-bedroom, 3-bath, with a 4-bed bunkroom, 2-story modern house conveniently located in the heart of Old Seagrove Beach and the middle of 30A. Just over 2 miles long, this free-spirited community is a balanced mix of old and new Florida and its laid-back style makes Seagrove Beach truly one of a kind. Casa Francisca is just a no-hassle short walk to the beach, approximately 1/3 of a mile, and enjoys 5 different dedicated neighborhood beach access points (more than any other beach along 30A) to more than one mile of open, deeded beach for your enjoyment. Close to nature trails, entertainment hubs, groceries, restaurants, boutique shops, and dune lakes, yet secluded, private, tranquil, and serene where you'll enjoy peace and relaxation. The open layout centered around the courtyard and pool is perfectly suited for families looking to reconnect and enjoy the afternoon breeze. Tastefully appointed rooms, with king-size beds in all of them, 2 on the main floor open to the pool, the third one on the second floor open to the outdoor terrace where you can enjoy the sunset. There is a large, fully stocked kitchen with every gadget you can think of and an outdoor grill. Beach towels, 4 beach chairs, and 4 bikes will be provided.
The wonders of Seagrove Beach and the comfort and convenience of Casa Francisca await your enjoyment. We look forward to having you as our guests.
